paper_title: SRPO Enhancing Multimodal LLM Reasoning via Reflection-Aware   Reinforcement Learning
caption_used: Accuracy comparison of six reinforcement learning configurations across three benchmarks: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. Each benchmark displays grouped bars for DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), DAPO (hatched blue), SRPO (solid orange), GRPO (hatched orange), PPO+Self-reflection (solid green), and PPO (hatched green). In Mathverse, SRPO achieves the highest accuracy at approximately 56%, while DAPO+Self-reflection follows at roughly 55%, with the remaining methods clustered between 53% and 54%. Across MMLU, GRPO leads with approximately 57%, narrowly exceeding DAPO+Self-reflection, and PPO trails at about 54.5%. In the Physics benchmark, DAPO+Self-reflection reaches roughly 61%, with SRPO close behind at 60.5% and PPO at the lowest with approximately 57%. Notably, the self-reflection variants do not consistently outperform their base counterparts, as GRPO surpasses PPO+Self-reflection in both Mathverse and MMLU.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: Диаграмата представя сравнение на точността (Accuracy, измерена в проценти) на шест различни конфигурации на усилващо учене (reinforcement learning) върху три бенчмарка: Mathverse, MMLU и Physics. Хоризонталната ос показва трите бенчмарка, подредени в азбучен ред, като всяка група от стълбове съответства на един бенчмарк. Вертикалната ос е етикетирана като „Accuracy (%)“ и използва линейна скала с диапазон от 50% до 62%, с отметки на всеки 2% (50, 52, 54, 56, 58, 60, 62). Всеки бенчмарк включва групирани стълбове, които представляват шестте метода: DAPO+Self-reflection (светло синьо, сплошно), DAPO (светло синьо, с хоризонтални линии), SRPO (оранжево, сплошно), GRPO (оранжево, с диагонални линии), PPO+Self-reflection (зелено, сплошно) и PPO (зелено, с диагонални линии). В Mathverse, най-високият стълб е на SRPO, достигащ приблизително 56%, следван от DAPO+Self-reflection на около 55%, докато останалите методи са в диапазона между 53% и 54%. В MMLU, GRPO има най-високата точност, около 57%, малко над DAPO+Self-reflection, което е около 56.5%, а PPO е най-ниско с около 54.5%. В Physics, DAPO+Self-reflection достига около 61%, SRPO е на около 60.5%, а PPO е най-ниско с около 57%. Стълбовете във всяка група са подредени по еднакъв ред, както е показано в легендата, без визуално подчертаване на определени стълбове чрез засенчване, удебеляване или допълнителни бележки.
model_annotations.Chinese: 该柱状图展示了六种强化学习配置在三个基准测试（Mathverse、MMLU 和 Physics）上的准确率比较。水平轴表示三个基准测试类别，按从左到右的顺序排列为 Mathverse、MMLU 和 Physics，属于类别轴，无数值刻度。垂直轴表示准确率（Accuracy (%)），标签为“Accuracy (%)”，刻度为线性，范围从 50% 到 62%，数值间隔为 2%，即每格代表 2% 的准确率提升。每个基准测试下包含六组分组柱状图，分别对应 DAPO+Self-reflection（实心蓝色）、DAPO（斜线填充蓝色）、SRPO（实心橙色）、GRPO（斜线填充橙色）、PPO+Self-reflection（实心绿色）和 PPO（斜线填充绿色），其颜色和填充样式在图例中明确标注。在 Mathverse 中，SRPO 的柱状图最高，约为 56%，DAPO+Self-reflection 约为 55%，其余方法的柱状图高度集中在 53% 至 54% 之间。在 MMLU 中，GRPO 的柱状图最高，约为 57%，DAPO+Self-reflection 紧随其后，约为 56.5%，PPO 的柱状图最低，约为 54.5%。在 Physics 中，DAPO+Self-reflection 的柱状图最高，约为 61%，SRPO 约为 60.5%，PPO 的柱状图最低，约为 57%。所有柱状图均未使用额外视觉强调（如阴影或加粗），且各组柱状图在每个基准测试内按图例顺序排列，无特定排序（如降序或字母顺序）。
model_annotations.English: The bar chart presents a comparison of accuracy percentages across three benchmarks—Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics—for six reinforcement learning configurations: DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), DAPO (hatched blue), SRPO (solid orange), GRPO (hatched orange), PPO+Self-reflection (solid green), and PPO (hatched green). The vertical axis represents accuracy in percentage, ranging from 50% to 62% with tick marks every 2 percentage points, while the horizontal axis lists the three benchmarks in left-to-right order. For each benchmark, the six methods are grouped together, with their respective bars arranged in the same order as specified in the legend. In Mathverse, SRPO achieves the highest accuracy at approximately 56%, followed by DAPO+Self-reflection at roughly 55.8%, while DAPO, GRPO, PPO+Self-reflection, and PPO are clustered between 53% and 54%. In MMLU, GRPO leads with approximately 57%, slightly ahead of DAPO+Self-reflection at about 56.8%, with SRPO at 57%, DAPO at 56%, and PPO+Self-reflection and PPO at around 54.5% and 54.3%, respectively. In Physics, DAPO+Self-reflection achieves the highest accuracy at approximately 61.2%, followed by SRPO at about 60.5%, while GRPO is at 58.2%, DAPO at 57.5%, PPO+Self-reflection at 58.8%, and PPO at approximately 57%. The self-reflection variants do not consistently outperform their base counterparts; for instance, GRPO outperforms PPO+Self-reflection in both Mathverse and MMLU, and DAPO+Self-reflection outperforms DAPO in all three benchmarks. The bars are visually distinct by color and pattern, and there is no explicit emphasis or annotation on any particular bar.
model_annotations.German: Das Balkendiagramm vergleicht die Genauigkeit (Accuracy) von sechs verschiedenen Verstärkungslernkonfigurationen – DAPO+Self-reflection (durchgezogene blaue Balken), DAPO (gestreifte blaue Balken), SRPO (durchgezogene orangefarbene Balken), GRPO (gestreifte orangefarbene Balken), PPO+Self-reflection (durchgezogene grüne Balken) und PPO (gestreifte grüne Balken) – auf drei Benchmarks: Mathverse, MMLU und Physics. Die x-Achse zeigt die drei Benchmarks in der Reihenfolge Mathverse, MMLU, Physics, wobei jede Kategorie eine Gruppe von sechs Balken enthält, die den jeweiligen Methoden zugeordnet sind. Die y-Achse ist linear skaliert und misst die Genauigkeit in Prozent, mit einem Wertebereich von 50% bis 62%, wobei die Tick-Beschriftungen in Schritten von 2% angegeben sind. In Mathverse erreicht SRPO den höchsten Wert bei etwa 56%, gefolgt von DAPO+Self-reflection bei etwa 55%, während die übrigen Methoden zwischen 53% und 54% liegen. Im MMLU-Benchmark führt GRPO mit etwa 57%, gefolgt von DAPO+Self-reflection bei etwa 56,5%, während PPO mit etwa 54,5% den niedrigsten Wert aufweist. Im Physics-Benchmark erzielt DAPO+Self-reflection die höchste Genauigkeit bei etwa 61%, gefolgt von SRPO bei etwa 60,5%, während PPO mit etwa 57% den niedrigsten Wert erreicht. Die Balken sind innerhalb jeder Benchmark-Gruppe nach der Legende angeordnet, wobei die Farben und Muster konsistent den jeweiligen Methoden zugeordnet sind. Es gibt keine visuelle Hervorhebung einzelner Balken durch Umrandung oder Schattierung, und die Reihenfolge der Balken innerhalb jeder Gruppe ist durch die Legende definiert, nicht durch eine Sortierung nach Höhe. Die Diagrammstruktur zeigt, dass die Selbstreflexionsvarianten (DAPO+Self-reflection, SRPO, PPO+Self-reflection) nicht konsistent besser abschneiden als ihre Basisvarianten (DAPO, SRPO, PPO), da GRPO in Mathverse und MMLU die entsprechende Selbstreflexionsmethode (PPO+Self-reflection) übertrifft.
